mission: Free 24/7 watchdogs for citizens: parliaments, laws, budgets, benefits, courts. Every run is logged, cited, and human-reviewed via PR. Agents never merge.

agents.name: GitLaw Law-Watch
agents.problem: Citizens cannot track new/amended federal laws; stale law causes wrong decisions
agents.impact_estimate: Prevents acting on stale law for 5,936-law corpus; ~4h/week manual corpus checks saved

agents.name: Bundestag-Watch
agents.problem: Lobby influence and MP actions are invisible to citizens
agents.impact_estimate: ~2h/day of manual monitoring per researcher replaced; lobbying becomes timestamped public data

agents.name: EU Citizen-Rights Watch
agents.problem: CJEU rulings change millions of claims; citizens and tools act on stale law
agents.impact_estimate: Protects €4-5B/yr unclaimed EU261; one CJEU ruling can shift millions of claims

agents.name: Money-Flow Watch
agents.problem: Citizens cannot see where tax money goes wrong
agents.impact_estimate: Accountability layer for €476.5B federal budget; anomaly alerts for journalists/citizens

agents.name: Benefit-Discovery Watch
agents.problem: ~800k households miss Wohngeld (€1B+/yr); eligibility rules change silently
agents.impact_estimate: €1B+/yr unclaimed Wohngeld + Elterngeld research time (5-15h/family) → one question

agents.name: Directive-Deadline Watch
agents.problem: Germany chronically transposes EU directives late; deadlines are invisible
agents.impact_estimate: Public deadline tracking per ministry; ends the silent-lateness failure mode

agents.name: Court-Watch
agents.problem: Landmark rulings change daily life but are written for lawyers
agents.impact_estimate: Plain-language alerts on rulings that change rights; feeds MCP jurisprudence

agents.name: Abuse-Safety Watch
agents.problem: Harassment-law changes (StGB/NetzDG) must stay current in SafeVoice's court-prep schema
agents.impact_estimate: Keeps the 30-second court-ready file route legally current for victims

agents.name: Procurement-Watch
agents.problem: Public tenders and awards hide anomalies (classic corruption vector, Gemeinde→Bund)
agents.impact_estimate: Anomaly flags on public spending; journalist/NGO tool

agents.name: Consultation-Watch
agents.problem: Consultation windows are invisible; citizens feel 'nothing I can do'
agents.impact_estimate: Turns apathy into a 10-minute submitted comment; participation uplift

principles: Every claim carries a source URL.
Agents draft, humans review, nobody auto-merges.
